steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: You know me, Utage.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Every week, I shop at Sunset Boulevard, have afternoon tea at the Seven Points Hotel, find places to take some nice photos, and always, always have Higashinese cuisine for Saturday dinners.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: But now? I had to borrow money to buy the latest Mango terminal, and I'm paying in installments too.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I'm broke, my dear. My wallet is as empty as my eyes.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So that's why you started selling this stuff at 'Origin Strife'? So what are those on the shelf?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Minimalist shoulder bags. The style is trending, so they're all sold out on Sunset Boulevard.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Didn't you use to call them 'pillow cases with shoulder straps'... Oh, and what are those? Slides?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Printed slides, to be precise. They're all the rage with people your age, didn't you know?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: By the way, I designed those prints by combining the most popular patterns from the past five years. I have three designs to choose from, and I'm sure they'll be popular enough.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: What happened to your older works? Like the 'Sexy Jail' and 'Dark Queen' stuff?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You used to love that 'Wild Jungle' series so much, but I only see a few hats from it... The burdenbeast pendants are gone too.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I... took the rest down.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Can I still buy them from you in the future?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I have to bid farewell to the past, my dear. Perhaps I could gift you a piece the next time you're here, but...

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I'll be real with you: I really, really appreciate you always supporting my designs and hanging out with me. I cherish all my children too.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: But they just don't sell. Ever since you left Lungmen, I have only a few regulars who drop by occasionally, and even fewer new customers.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: More importantly, my dad stopped giving me money.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: He recently married a Lupo woman and told me he can't afford to support me financially anymore. I have to rely on myself now, or I'll be out on the streets.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I... can't live the way I used to anymore, mooching off my dad and roping you in to work on my so-called art.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So.... have you made any money yet?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Currently... no.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Give it time! Believe me, I just need some time.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: The high-end market may still be dominated by older brands like MARTHE and 0011, but you can find the trendsetters of today just about anywhere now.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: 'Minimalist,' 'Functional,' 'Neo-Retro,' 'Streetwear'... To seize a trend is to seize the future!

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Just look at the stuff I have here. What customers want is 'real fashion' like this, not some artsy nonsense.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: The overall sales volume speaks for itself, and combined with my talent... I'm sure someone will eventually discover the much better designs they can only get here.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Also... I applied for the Spring Pop Fashion Show under the Emerging Designers category, so I've been busy prepping for that too.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: There won't be any big names there. It's mostly a showcase of trendy designs, so it'll be a pretty good chance for me to get some exposure.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Didn't you use to hate those big fashion shows?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You used to say they were... 'for egotistical bigshots, and full of incompetent designers trying every trick in the book to grab attention.'

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Well, I thought it over again recently, and they're not that bad.

spans.text: Well, I thought it over again recently, and they're not

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I was young then, and not desperate enough for cash...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Give it to me straight, Zizhen... do you really think your designs are inferior to those sold elsewhere?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: At least their stuff sells.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Ah. Some nuisance is knocking on my door again.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Let's talk later, Zizhen. And gimme all those hats.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Same 20% discount as usual?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I'm sorry, my dear, but I can't do discounts anymore.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Anyway, maybe making a change isn't such a bad idea, Zizhen.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Alright, best of luck with your show.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: A fashion show, hm? Haven't been to something like that in a real long time.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hm... could be fun, once in a while.
A day before the Spring Pop Fashion Show

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Hmm... if my info was right, it should be here.)

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Have a pleasant trip, ladies.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Lady
steps.text: Did you hear? Mr. Blanche would never have attended a show with so many amateurs if he weren't stuck in a design rut and looking for inspiration.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Lady
steps.text: I'd expect no less from a famous designer. Even the way he speaks and acts is extraordinary.

steps.name: Stunningly Dressed Lady
steps.text: Ha, is he still on your mind? Tomorrow night is for socializing, so you can just have a few drinks with him then.

spans.text: on your mind? Tomorrow night is for socializing, so you can just have a few drinks with him then.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Lady
steps.text: What nonsense are you on about?!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Excuse me, Miss. May I see your invitation?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Invitation? Oh, I'm so sorry, but I was in a hurry and forgot to bring it with me.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Apologies, but the pre-show cocktail party is invitation-only, so I can't let you enter without one.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, this is how you're going to play it... Do you even know who I am?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: A... fashionable looking student?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Surely you've heard of Mr. Blanche?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Blanche? That famous Leithanian designer?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Yeah. He's here at the party tonight, isn't he? I'll let you in on a secret, he's the organizer's special guest.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: I did see him earlier...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: *sigh* Let me just say, famous artists like him are pretty eccentric, and just love ordering people around.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I'm his assistant while he's in Lungmen. I was just with him, but he forgot an extremely important design draft at his studio.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So I went back to bring it over, but accidentally left my invitation behind.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Is that so? But I don't remember seeing you before... Can you show me any proof?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, you can come with me to look for Mr. Blanche.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But if we disturb him in the middle of an enjoyable conversation... Well, I don't even know what will happen.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Also, you said you don't remember seeing me, but do you remember the two ladies who just left?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Of course. One of them was wearing a red jacket, and the other a dark purple cheongsam.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You clearly forgot then. One of them was obviously wearing a bright purple cardigan from MARTHE's autumn collection, and the other a custom red cheongsam from EPOQUE.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: You're kidding?! My memory has always been pretty good!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Do you remember what color Mr. Blanche's suit is then?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Of course! It should be... a dark gray suit?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Yes, no... wait, let me think... Was it black? No, that's not it...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: See? So no surprise you don't remember me... Ah, I've been dallying here for so long, I hope Mr. Blanche doesn't get mad.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Wait... Argh, why does the guy on the next shift just happen to be on break right now?!

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Tell you what, you go in first and deliver your thing to Mr. Blanche, then I'll come in ASAP to verify everything. Don't forget.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hehe, much appreciated.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, that was easy.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Alright, the next step is...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, over there.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hello there. Sorry to disturb you, Mr. Blanche.

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I'm a university student from Higashi studying in Yan, majoring in art history and working part-time as a reporter for the school newspaper.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So, we're currently doing a segment where we interview and record the daily lives of well-known contemporary artists at work.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: People see you as one of the greats of the fashion industry. You're a figure young artists admire and follow, as well as personal hero to me since forever.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Seeing how it's so rare for you to visit Lungmen, I thought I couldn't let this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity slip.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So, if you could just grant me an interview during the show...?

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: An interview? I don't have time in my schedule for that sort of thing.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I won't disrupt your schedule at all, I just need to follow you around and record some footage during the show.

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Listen, child. There's a reason I've taken the time to come all the way to Lungmen and participate in a foreign fashion show held by a group whose names I don't even know—

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: It's because I crave true beauty... I have no time to play house with some student reporter while on my sacred quest.

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Wait... how did you even get in here?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: About that. I had a chat with my uncle about this event, and he gave me an invite I used to get in.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And if my article is good enough, he said he'd orchestrate a special fashion show back home, and invite famous designers from all over Terra. I'd be able to publish another article too.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You're aware that our clothing back home is pretty unique, right?

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Of course I am! Higashi, was it...? Higashi...

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Well, if it's just an interview... Let me see. If you promise not to interfere with my schedule, I do technically have a bit of time to spare.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: R-Really? Thank you so, so much—so when exactly tomorrow...?

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: I'll have my assistant send you my address later. I'll arrive here tomorrow at nine-o-clock sharp, and you will attend the show with me.

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: But keep in mind that I loathe tardiness.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Have any of you seen a guest that looks like a university student?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hey, Mr. Security. Over here.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: Were you... talking with Mr. Blanche just now? You're really his assistant?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: How could I possibly lie to you?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: ...Sorry for doubting you earlier.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: No biggie. Fortunately, you let me in, and Mr. Blanche is quite satisfied.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Right, and I... want to ask you about a private matter.

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, it's Mr. Blanche. He's planning to stay in Lungmen for a few more days, but didn't bring a bodyguard with him this time, so he's looking for a trustworthy local.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: He left me to sort it out, and the pay's pretty generous.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So I was thinking... You guys were probably hired by the show organizers for the event's duration, right?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: And you've been so professional about it too. Any chance you do personal commissions too?

steps.name: Party Security Detail
steps.text: I... Do you really think I'm capable?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, I still need to ask you some basic interview questions first. Just for form's sake, you know how it is... For example...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Right, can you tell me about the security arrangements for the show?

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Sorry, but we're about to close for the day.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, that's alright, I'm just looking.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Please come again!
She walks down the stairs until her feet are both firmly on the ground. Her thoughts suddenly shift, and she turns around.
The staff member is busy removing the last few items embodying the shop's history from the establishment Utage is all-too familiar with.
She knows that when she's done, it will take on a brand-new, bright and beautiful look.
Just like the neon-lit fashion shops on Sunset Boulevard.
The old signboard, which has remained unchanged for a long time, flickers twice before finally going out.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Hah—barkeep, pour me another one!

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: That's your third one already, young lady.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Work's been so stressful, how else am I supposed to relax?

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: The more you drink, the more you forget all the little annoyances.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Didn't you change jobs a while back? You said the new place was a pretty decent designer brand shop. What was the name again...?

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: 'Origin Strife.'

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: Yeah, wasn't it featured in some fashion magazine too? Recommended by the famous art critic 'Pink Katana,' even.

steps.name: Bar Owner
steps.text: It used to be a tiny hole-in-the-wall, but suddenly exploded in popularity. My wife's been pestering me to go shopping there these last few days, but I feel like they sell the same clothes as everywhere else.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: *sigh* Enough about that—

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Evening.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Er, aren't you... the customer from earlier?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Thanks for taking care of the store while Zizhen's been busy with the fashion show.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Are you a friend of hers?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, I guess you could say that.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: *sigh*... Running the store is the easy part; I can deal with customers just fine. The hard part is... managing the stock.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: There have been more customers these days, and there's no space for all the new goods in the old warehouse.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: So Miss Zizhen took a loan to rent a new warehouse and wants everything moved over.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Isn't the old one filled with all her pet projects? Must be a pain to move them.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Yeah, she left it so messy when she was handling it. It's a pain to sort out because she just stacked everything into a big pile.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: I mean... I even found a bed and some toiletries in there!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh yeah, I spent a few nights crashing there.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: When I ran into some trouble and didn't want anyone finding out, I borrowed her place for a few days... It's ancient history now, don't worry about it.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: It took me a few days of hard work just to move the new products out. Now all that's left is her old stuff.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: I took a look at them... They're pretty good. More stylish than the current stuff. I don't get why she decided to change her style... *hic*

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Enough thinking. *hic* I just need to put in some elbow grease.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You seem kinda drunk, maybe you should call it a night.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: W-Who said I was drunk?! I have pretty good alcohol tolerance, I'll have you know! Just watch me! Barkeep, pour me another!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, sorry for underestimating you. Guess I'll have to keep you company then.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Unfortunately I'm allergic to alcohol, so I'll stick to orange juice.

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Who cares! Just drink!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Tsk, tsk. She's definitely smashed if she bought that excuse.)

spans.text: (Tsk, tsk. She's definitely smashed if she bought

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: To your new life, and to 'Origin Strife'!

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: To 'Origin Strife'!

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Ahh—this is great. Only... I'm feeling a bit dizzy...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hehe, I'll let you in on a little secret. Zizhen can be pretty careless.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: She used to keep the key on top of the door panel at the old warehouse, or else she'd lose it. Take care of her for me, alright?

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: Haha, you know it! But she's changed things up, and now it's under the rock right by the door!

steps.name: Shop Staff
steps.text: But don't worry, just leave it to me.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Thanks, I knew I could count on you.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Yawn)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Alright, that should take care of all the prep work, more or less.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Ah, now I'm excited for tomorrow's show.
She feels beads of sweat condensing on her palm, and curls her fingers as she puts her hand in her pocket.
She feels the cold metal as she removes it from her jacket.
A 'Wild Jungle' series burdenbeast pendant lies quietly in the palm of her hand.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Now this, this is cute.
Day of the Spring Pop Fashion Show

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: No, no, you're too kind. I'm not talented at all, I've just been fortunate enough to be taught by some amazing people.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I didn't plan any sort of surprise, really. I have so much more to learn from you all.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Sorry, please excuse me for a moment. I need to check on the show plan again.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Things are going so smoothly thanks to that guy.)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (The clothes were a bit annoying, but at least it's over and done with. Next up, accessories... they should be keeping them around here, right?)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Target spotted! Huh? Along with two security guards...)

steps.name: Warehouse Guard A
steps.text: Did you hear something from above just now?

steps.name: Warehouse Guard B
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard A
steps.text: Was I just hearing things? It can't be—Ah! Why'd you just hit my head?!

steps.name: Warehouse Guard B
steps.text: What? Why would I do that? The models are about to change their outfits, so hurry up and move this stuff!

steps.name: Warehouse Guard A
steps.text: Don't play dumb with me! What's that in your hand?

steps.name: Warehouse Guard B
steps.text: My hand—? Huh? Where'd this hammer come from?

steps.name: Warehouse Guard A
steps.text: Man, you really...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Pfft.

steps.name: Event Security Detail
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: Event Security Detail
steps.text: How... what are you doing here?

steps.name: Event Security Detail
steps.text: Oh, I get it. You must be here with Mr. Blanche to check things over before the show begins.

steps.name: Event Security Detail
steps.text: ...Does he really think I'm suited for the job?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Sheesh, stop worrying so much! I got it all settled. Just do your best!

steps.name: Event Security Detail
steps.text: Sure, I'll give it a try.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Utage? What brings you here?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Evening, Zizhen.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Oh, I know. You came to get the latest scoop?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: ...It's complicated. Anyway, gotta go.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Utage.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Need something?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Don't blame me. I know you're a big fan of my old work, and I'll definitely make it up to you later.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: But you have to understand why I'm doing this. This is what it means to be a designer.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: You like playful and pretty things, and your taste is impeccable. But you're still just a student.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: You don't understand the true value of what I'm doing.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Heh. Maybe it's you who doesn't understand.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Fashion isn't always about coming up with the most appealing design. You don't get labeled 'fashionable' just because a ton of people like it.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But seeing how you think your work needs outside approval to become 'real' fashion, we'll just have to give everyone a good look.

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Excuse me, but the show is about to begin and we need to clear the backstage, so if you two ladies could return to your seats...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Okay, I won't spoil your fun anymore. Please enjoy your... unique fashion show.

steps.name: Female Designer
steps.text: Miss Ye, I believe you're up first in the Emerging Designers category?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Female Designer
steps.text: Hahaha. Today's going to be so eye-opening for those old-timers, right from the start.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: (Swirling wineglass)

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Utage...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: Miss Ye? Miss Ye Zizhen!

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: I'm over here.... What's the matter?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I need to confirm something with you.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Calm down. What is it?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: When I was backstage, I noticed that your showcase items didn't match the list you submitted beforehand. Someone claiming to be your assistant said you decided on a last minute change for a better reception.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: How is that possible?! I told the head stylist about the draping issue with the top pieces earlier... How would he not notice?

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: The head stylist and I saw you talking to the person in question backstage earlier, so... it didn't seem too suspicious.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Could it be... Utage?!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: The head stylist thought anyone already inside the event couldn't possibly be suspicious, and that every designer would be at the reception, so it was perfectly natural to send an assistant to carry out your changes...

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: But I was still a little uneasy, so I came over to confirm...

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Stop the show! Stop it now! Let me go backstage!

steps.name: Staff Worker
steps.text: I'm afraid... it's too late now.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, good evening to you all.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: A warm welcome to everyone gathered here on this beautiful night to participate in our Spring Pop Fashion Show.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Without further ado, I will now hand the opening over to our emerging designers. These young artisans are the future of design, and their works will surely shine brightly on-stage.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: First up are the brand new creations of Miss Ye Zizhen.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Wait—

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Haha. It seems like Miss Ye here is a little shy, but truth be told, she has dedicated her all for this show. Why, just before I came on stage her assistant even handed me a special introduction to read.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: 'Inspired by the primitive jungles of Sargon, the power of life lies within the rugged rawness of nature, incorporated into a unique urban aesthetic to create an original style.'

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Please enjoy the newest release from the 'Wild Jungle' series.
The brilliant lights seem to drip down onto the rough and wild patterns, like gold seeping from the remote wilderness into modern civilization.
The models carry on with their rehearsed poses, the contrasting juxtaposition of their shockingly exaggerated accessories and their outfits exuding an intense glamor.

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Sir! Please wait! This is a mistake!

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: Stop! Stop the showcase!

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: It's so over...

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Ye... Miss Ye.

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Is this really your work?

steps.name: Ye Zizhen
steps.text: No, it's not... I mean, yes, but it's an old collection I'd already abandoned! I didn't intend to showcase these!

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: It's so... exquisite! Brimming with the vitality of nature!

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Primitivity and modernity, nature and civilization. Who knew they could harmonize so wonderfully in these designs?

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: The purest form of beauty—like how a child would look at things. Something I've been painstakingly searching for... you've actually given it form.

steps.name: Blanche
steps.text: Miss Ye Zizhen! You've done some outstanding work here!
His voice is far from loud, but everyone present is sure they could clearly hear the famous designer's evaluation.
Then, applause erupts from all over the venue, finally forming a sea of congratulations.
Ye Zizhen sits back in her chair, unable to utter a word amidst the clamor and cheers.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Utage! So here's where you were, I've been looking for ya.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Evening.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Whoa! Got yer nails done again?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Isn't it pretty? I went with a darkcore look this time.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ah, almost forgot why I was lookin' for ya. Y'know that 'Wild Jungle' series that's been all the rage in Lungmen these days?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh yeah?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What, ya don't? It got real popular after some show, and now we got brands everywhere in Lungmen makin' clothes and accessories in that fashion!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So, I wanted to ask yer opinion, seeing how yer the famous 'Pink Katana' and all... Hey!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That pendant ya got on! It's from that 'Wild Jungle' series, right?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: How do I put it? The line has an interesting concept, but the designer herself is a little boring. Basically, I'd only recommend buying one or two pieces from the collection.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But the sudden rise in popularity... tsk, tsk. Maybe just a coincidence?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Phew. I can relax now that I've gotten a positive review from ya.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Right, I hear the shop behind this line is offerin' a sale recently, twenty percent off! Interested?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: That so? Then—

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Time for another shopping trip.
